concretize.definitionKo: 사물이나 예술 작품을 일정한 형태와 성질을 갖춘 것으로 되게 하다.
concretize.englishDescription: To make an object or work of art take on certain shape and quality.

concretize.definitionKo: 비현실적이고 막연한 것을 실제적이고 자세한 형태와 성질을 가지게 하다.
concretize.englishDescription: To make something unrealistic and vague have a realistic and concrete form and quality.

counterfeiting.definitionKo: 진짜를 본떠서 가짜를 만듦. 또는 그렇게 만든 물건.
counterfeiting.englishDescription: The act of making a fake item by imitating the original, or such an item.

crawlingly.definitionKo: 몸을 바닥에 대고 엎드려서 작은 동작으로 기는 모양.
crawlingly.englishDescription: In the manner of crawling with small movements, lying on one's stomach.

crawlingly.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 남에게 잘 보이기 위해 자신을 낮추어 비굴하게 행동하는 모양.
crawlingly.englishDescription: (figurative) In the manner of behaving servilely while humbling oneself in order to please another person.

crawlingly.definitionKo: 큰 동작으로 느리게 걷거나 기어가는 모양.
crawlingly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of walking or crawling slowly with big movements.

lifestyle.definitionKo: 한 사회나 집단에 속한 사람들이 공통적으로 가지고 있는 삶의 방식.
lifestyle.englishDescription: A way of life shared by the members of a society or group.

prodigy.englishDescription: An intelligent child who has a great talent.
A child who is very talented.

schism.definitionKo: 갈라져서 따로 자리함. 또는 나누어서 자리하게 함.
schism.englishDescription: Things being divided and separately established; the process of dividing and separately establishing things.

systemization.definitionKo: 일정한 원리에 따라 낱낱의 부분이 잘 짜여져 통일된 전체로 됨. 또는 그렇게 되게 함.
systemization.englishDescription: A state in which a set of individual parts are organized into a collective entity according to certain rules, or making something be in such a state.

unhurt.definitionKo: 흠이나 다친 곳 등이 없고 온전하다.
흠이나 다친 곳 등이 없고 온전한 상태로.
unhurt.englishDescription: In the state of being intact without flaws, wounds, etc.

unsuitable.englishDescription: A person's words or actions not being in accord with his/her circumstances.
Not suitable for a certain job or standard.

unsuitable.definitionKo: 어떤 일이나 상황 등에 알맞지 않다.
unsuitable.englishDescription: Not suitable for a certain job or situation.
Not suitable for a certain job or condition.
